title: Select a chart region through the semantic surface
purpose: Demonstrate that a graphical region is resolved through the same semantic service path as text, using a bounded semantic hint and preserving Diderot provenance plus runtime evidence.
preconditions: The Study 0 chart is visible and the PCA 128D bar is rendered.
E2E evidence mode is enabled for the qualification run only.

messages.label: Select PCA bar region
messages.expected: Hit-test identifies Study 0 route index 1 and semantic hint study0.route.1.

messages.label: Emit figure-region selection
messages.expected: Selection text is PCA 128D and elementType is figure-region.

messages.label: POST figure selection + semantic hint
messages.expected: HTTP API receives a bounded figure-region request.

messages.label: Resolve whitelisted semantic hint
messages.expected: semantic.id = concept:pca, source.tier = diderot, fallback.required = false.

messages.label: Return PCA explanation
messages.expected: Interactive panel title is PCA and provenance stays Diderot.

messages.label: Emit figure semantic + explanation signals
messages.expected: selection.type = figure-region, semantic.id = concept:pca, source = diderot, transport = api.

messages.label: OTLP traces / logs / metrics
messages.expected: GET root SpanId recovers the expected figure-selection subtree and validator returns PASS.

steps.title: Select the PCA graphical region
steps.action: Click the PCA 128D bar in the Study 0 canvas.
expected: The source label is Diderot · api.
The displayed intuition includes unsupervised linear projection.

steps.title: Verify the figure semantic API contract
steps.action: Call POST /api/semantic/v1/resolve with elementType figure-region and semanticHint study0.route.1.

steps.title: Recover and verify figure runtime evidence
steps.action: Flush OTLP signals and query the evidence bundle by the Playwright root SpanId.
expected: The semantic.resolve span records figure-region, PCA 128D, concept:pca, source diderot and transport api.
The explanation.render span is correlated to concept:pca.
Expected logs and metric exemplars are correlated.
The executable telemetry contract verdict is PASS.
